decisions.reason: The four-week warm-up duration and one-month warm-up subscription do not change the registered domain, registrar, or domain-creation requirement.
The warm-up duration does not alter the campaign domain's web-forwarding destination or behavior.
Domain warm-up timing does not change the mailbox requirement for Gmail compatibility.
The source concerns the duration and subscription for domain warm-up, not MeetAlfred configuration or its Pro subscription plan.
The one-month subscription discussed is for domain warm-up and does not change Zapier's Pro plan or add-on selection.
Although domain warm-up may precede email campaigning, the source does not change the deferred campaign's channel, automation mode, platform, or lifecycle.
Domain email warm-up timing does not change the LinkedIn campaign's automation behavior or platform.
The warm-up duration does not alter the deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization method or lifecycle.
The source does not change restrictions on using production leads or the preferred non-production test identity.
The domain warm-up duration has no necessary effect on preserving existing MeetAlfred integrations and campaigns.
The source does not change the silent-lead follow-up workflow, cleanup rule, or deferred lifecycle.
The one-month warm-up subscription is unrelated to HubSpot's Starter subscription plan and CRM use.
